title: No-Show Reserve on Visits Leaving a Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
**Attendance policy extract.** A Self-Pay Visit Package keeps a no-show reserve back from a transfer, so that a further missed appointment on the series can still be forfeited from the giving package: where the Appointment Series the package funds is paused, active or booked, **2 visits** are kept back where the no-shows recorded on package-funded appointments have reached the package's number of missed appointments not forfeited, and **1 visit** where they are exactly one short of it; otherwise none. The visits kept back are subtracted from the standing visits.

**Records read.** The no-show entries on package-funded appointments in the patient's Appointment Series history; the status of the Appointment Series linked to the package; the tier's number of missed appointments not forfeited.

**Thresholds by tier (series paused, active or booked)**

| Tier | Missed appointments not forfeited | 2 visits kept back at | 1 visit kept back at |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | 0 | 0 or more no-shows | — |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | 1 | 1 or more no-shows | 0 no-shows |
| Core 8-Visit Package | 1 | 1 or more no-shows | 0 no-shows |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | 1 | 1 or more no-shows | 0 no-shows |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | 0 | 0 or more no-shows | — |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | 2 | 2 or more no-shows | exactly 1 no-show |

**Truth table (Comprehensive 24-Visit Package)**

| Series status | No-shows | Visits kept back |
|---|---|---|
| active | 0 | none |
| active | 1 | 1 |
| paused | 2 | 2 |
| booked | 3 | 2 |
| completed or cancelled | any | none |
